newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Apr single-family home sales fell 7.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Apr single-family home sales fell 7.7 pct.

text.p: U.S. Commerce Department reported sales of new single-family homes, seasonally adjusted, with percent changes from prior month (numbers in 1,000s).
Total April sales of single-family homes rose 4.2 percent from an annualized rate of 741,000 units a year ago.
Note-Actual number of new single-family units sold is not seasonally adjusted.
Wall Street economists forecast April single-family home sales at a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 800,000 units.
The department also revised monthly percent changes of total sales, seasonally adjusted, from prior months as follows:
The annualized sales rate for January was revised to 822,000 units from 825,000.
Number of Months: Apr Mar-(Prev) Feb-(Prev)

The April drop in single-family home sales was the biggest monthly decrease since October's decline of 8.1 percent. The April inventory of homes was at its lowest level since August 1993, when it also stood at 286,000.
The March sales rate of 836,000 was the strongest sales month in nearly 11 years, the department said.
